title: GCC Sanctions & Terror-List Screener
description: Paste names (one per line). Each is screened against OFAC SDN + Consolidated, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, the EU and UK sanctions lists and the UAE Local Terrorist List; one dataset row per unique name with decision_hint (clear / review / likely_match), score and the top hits. Charged $0.01 per unique name. In Standby mode this Actor is also an MCP server at /mcp (screen_name with DOB / nationality / ID, screen_batch, audit_report, list_status, explain_match).

names.title: Names to screen
names.description: One person or company per line, Latin or Arabic script (up to 5,000 per run). Duplicates are screened once.

text.title: Or paste text with one name per line
text.description: Lines (or semicolon-separated items) are treated as names.

nationality.title: Default nationality (ISO2)
nationality.description: Applied to every name: 'AE', 'IR', 'GB'… A nationality mismatch with the listed entry lowers the score by 5; a match raises it by 3.

entity_type.title: Type of the names
entity_type.description: individual, entity (companies, organisations), vessel, aircraft or any.

min_score.title: Minimum score
min_score.description: Hits below this score (0–100) are not reported. 85 is the default; 80 widens the net for onboarding, 92 for alert review.
